# origincloud_kms_key (Resource)

A key: its versions' material is kept by the platform and never leaves it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) The project the key is in. Changing it replaces the key.
- `purpose` (String) What the key is for. One of `ENCRYPT_DECRYPT`, `SIGN_ECDSA_P256_SHA256`, `SIGN_ED25519`. Changing it replaces the key.
- `region` (String) The region the key is in. Changing it replaces the key.

### Optional

- `state` (String) Whether the key can be used. A new key is `ENABLED`; UpdateKey sets it to `ENABLED` or `DISABLED`, and DeleteKey makes it `DELETED`. One of `ENABLED`, `DISABLED`, `DELETED`. Left out, it keeps its current value; see the field's description.
- `tags` (Map of String) Labels of your own, at most 50. The `origin:name` tag is the name the console shows.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) When the key was created. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `id` (String) The key's full resource name, `//kms.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`: what an argument that refers to the key takes. `name` is the relative name, without the host.
- `name` (String) The key's resource name.
- `platform_managed` (Boolean) Whether the platform manages the key: it made the key in your project for its own use of the project's data, such as the key, tagged `origin:name=volumes`, that protects your volumes' data keys. You see it, its grants and its audit log entries like any key of yours, but UpdateKey, DeleteKey, UndeleteKey and RotateKey refuse it with `FORBIDDEN`, whatever roles you hold.
- `primary_version` (String) The full name of the version new ciphertexts and signatures use.
- `purge_time` (String) When a deleted key's material is destroyed, or was; unset unless the key is `DELETED`. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `update_time` (String) When the key last changed. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `versions` (Attributes List) Every version, oldest first. RotateKey adds one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String) When the version was created. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `key_version` (String) The version's full name, `//kms.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}/versions/{version}`, numbered from 1.
